metadata.loading: hydrostatic stress, p=1 by force / p0; radius=.01, div=1, common/sparse adapters
metadata.reference: periodic checkerboard 2x2; common/3d_periodic weakest motif; same-pressure member mapping
metadata.core: all owner tiles [lo+w,hi-w)^d; edge slots include assigned boundary members
metadata.force_metric: min_s ||f-s*f_P||_2 / ||f_P||_2; f=axial forces, companion complete end-wrench metric
metadata.anisotropy: ||dev(mean sigma)||_F / ||(tr(mean sigma)/d) I||_F; full symmetrized end-force virial
metadata.fit_limitations: one deterministic background per L; nested correlated patches; fixed L/R and shrinking-matrix bias; no asymptotic-rate proof
